🎥🎬: Futurama (1999–Present)

Welcome to the 31st century, where robots have attitudes, aliens are everywhere, and delivering a package can somehow turn into an intergalactic disaster. Fry, a pizza delivery guy from the year 1999, finds himself thrown into this strange future after being accidentally frozen for a thousand years.

Joining Planet Express, Fry quickly becomes part of an unusual crew that includes the tough and capable Leela, the chaotic robot Bender, eccentric Professor Farnsworth, and several other unforgettable characters. Together, they take on dangerous deliveries and ridiculous adventures across Earth, distant planets, and sometimes even through time itself.

Through all the futuristic madness, Futurama mixes comedy, friendship, adventure, and clever sci-fi storytelling as Fry slowly discovers that life in the future might be exactly where he belongs.

Stream an all-new season of Futurama August 3 on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

source_details.synopsis: Futurama is an American animated science fiction sitcom created by Matt Groening and developed by Groening and David X. Cohen for the Fox Broadcasting Company, and later revived by Comedy Central and then Hulu. The series follows Philip J. Fry, a young man who is cryogenically preserved for 1,000 years and revived on December 31, 2999. Fry finds work at the interplanetary delivery company Planet Express, working alongside the one-eyed mutant Leela and the robot Bender. The series was envisioned by Groening in the mid-1990s while working on The Simpsons; he brought Cohen, a Simpsons writer, aboard to develop storylines and characters to pitch the show to Fox.
